test_cases.title: A read-only web service operation returns its result for known identifiers
acs: DERIVED: Parameterised Get/Fetch/List/Find/Is/Has/Count operations return a SOAP result for existing identifiers - 22 operations (web service source)
assumptions: The web services run at http://localhost:1935 and need no sign-in locally. Identifiers come from the local database and Web.config (data in scripts/generate-soap-args.mjs).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Only read-style operations are called, so nothing is written.
Identifiers that were not found in the data are sent as the empty Guid.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 22 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Send a SOAP POST for the operation and arguments in the row.

steps.expected: The body is a SOAP envelope.

test_cases.title: A read-only web service operation answers with a SOAP envelope for unknown identifiers
acs: DERIVED: Operations called with unknown identifiers answer with a SOAP envelope (result or fault), never an HTML error page - 22 operations (web service source)
assumptions: The web services run at http://localhost:1935 and need no sign-in locally. Identifiers come from the local database and Web.config (data in scripts/generate-soap-args.mjs).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
The token stays valid; every other identifier is the empty Guid or zero.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 22 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Send a SOAP POST for the operation with empty identifiers.

steps.expected: The body is a SOAP envelope.

steps.action: Check that the body is not an HTML page.
steps.expected: No HTML error page is returned.
The status is 200 or 500 with a soap:Fault.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from the web service source; confirm the expected behaviour for unknown identifiers.
